name: prompt-architect
description: Turns rough Turkish or English requests into structured, domain-aware expert prompts tuned per model for Claude (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable) and OpenAI Codex (GPT-6.x, GPT-5.6), with a quality-gate self-review

interface.shortDescription: Model-aware expert prompts for Claude and Codex
interface.longDescription: Detects the host and active model, loads the matching Claude or OpenAI GPT profile, classifies the domain, picks prompting patterns and drafts an English expert prompt with a quality-gate self-review. Accepts Turkish or English input and can execute the deliverable on request.
defaultPrompt: Turn this into an expert prompt
Write this prompt for GPT-6.1 Sol
